subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be split into a heartbeat wake precedence bugfix first, or should it also change Telegram DMs away from the documented default main-session behavior?
rationale: The heartbeat precedence path is a concrete source-reproducible bug, but changing Telegram DM default routing would alter documented compatibility behavior for existing users.

options.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
options.body: Fix event-triggered heartbeats so explicit `heartbeat.session` wins, while leaving Telegram DM default behavior controlled by `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

options.title: Bundle Telegram DM isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs to isolate by default in the same work, accepting the upgrade, docs, and migration implications for users relying on main-session continuity.

options.title: Defer to broader heartbeat scheduling
options.body: Hold the concrete fix behind native per-session heartbeat scheduling work, which may be cleaner but leaves the current forced-session contamination path unresolved longer.

recommendation.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
recommendation.body: Fix event-triggered heartbeats so explicit `heartbeat.session` wins, while leaving Telegram DM default behavior controlled by `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is tied to both the original heartbeat session feature merge and later routing/session hardening work, making him the strongest available routing decision owner from history.
